title: Food Science
description: Cooking is chemistry against the clock: the Maillard reactions that brown a crust speed up steeply with temperature, as every reaction does by Arrhenius's law, and yeast leavens dough by fermenting its sugar. A ration baked right keeps for months. Unlocks Field Rations.

puzzle.goal: A browning reaction runs at a rate k that rises with temperature T: a fraction e^(−E/RT) of collisions has the activation energy E it needs. Write k, with A the rate at infinite temperature.
puzzle.name: The Arrhenius rate
puzzle.ask: Find k in 1/s for a crust: A = @{A} 1/s, E = @{E} J/mol, R = @{R} J/(mol·K), T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: The Boltzmann factor: the share of molecules with energy above E goes as e^(−E/RT).
